children: Located in northern Hyderabad, Kompally is an emerging residential and commercial hub, benefiting from the city's expanding urban landscape

Lemon Tree Hotels Limited has announced the signing of Lemon Tree Hotel, Kompally, taking its portfolio in Telangana to nine hotels, including five in Hyderabad. The property will be managed by Carnation Hotels Private Limited, a wholly-owned subsidiary of the company.

Located in northern Hyderabad, Kompally is an emerging residential and commercial hub, benefiting from the city's expanding urban landscape. The micro-market is attracting business and leisure travellers seeking convenient access to the wider Hyderabad region.
The hotel will feature 96 well-appointed rooms, a restaurant, banquet facilities, meeting and conference rooms, a swimming pool and a fitness centre, along with other public areas.

Commenting on the signing, Vishvapreet Singh Cheema, President, Lemon Tree Hotels Ltd., said, "Hyderabad's continued momentum as a business and commercial centre is creating opportunities beyond its established hubs. Our micro-market-led strategy enables us to identify these growth avenues and build a presence in locations with distinct demand drivers. Our operational hotels in corporate hubs such as HITEC City and Gachibowli, the established residential and commercial neighbourhood of Banjara Hills and now the addition of a hotel in the fast-growing residential suburb of Kompally reflect this approach. With this signing, our portfolio in Telangana will comprise nine hotels, including four operational and five upcoming properties."
Gundla Pochampally Railway Station is approximately 7 km from the property, while Rajiv Gandhi International Airport, Hyderabad, is approximately 48 km away.
